content.title: U.S. Treasury Yields Edge Higher, Direction Seeking Continues
content.summary: U.S. Treasury yields were rising, paring some of Thursday's decline, with the 10-year Treasury yield remaining above the 4% level.  Meanwhile, Treasury markets continued to navigate the government shutdown that leaves investors with limited access to data.  "The data vacuum means clarity is tough to find, as illustrated by contrasting survey data from Wednesday and Thursday," said ING's Padhraic Garvey and Benjamin Schroeder in a note.

content.title: U.S. 10-Year Treasury Yield Seen Settling Above 4% For Now
content.summary: The 10-year U.S. Treasury yield "seems content at above 4% for now," ING's Padhraic Garvey and Benjamin Schroeder said in a note.  U.S. Treasury yields closed lower on Tuesday but the falls were small.  U.S. Treasury yields edged lower, with the 10-year yield down 1.9 basis points at 4.070%, according to Tradeweb data.

content.title: Voya Financial (NYSE:VOYA) Reports Strong Q3
content.summary: Financial services company Voya Financial (NYSE:VOYA) reported Q3 CY2025 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 14% year on year to $2.13 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.45 per share was 8.9% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
